items.question: Trong câu "Maybe the application does exactly what they need, maybe it is easy to learn, maybe it is blazingly fast, maybe it has never crashed.", từ "blazingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maybe the application does exactly what they need, maybe it is easy to learn, maybe it is blazingly fast, maybe it has never crashed.", what does "blazingly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: blazingly /ˈbleɪ.zɪŋ.li/ (trạng từ): cực kỳ, vô cùng. "Blazingly fast" là cụm cố định = nhanh kinh khủng; gốc "blaze" là ngọn lửa bùng cháy.
items.explanationEn: blazingly /ˈbleɪ.zɪŋ.li/ (adverb): extremely, very. "Blazingly fast" is a fixed phrase meaning extremely fast; "blaze" originally means a strong fire.

items.question: Trong câu "The key point: greatness lies along many dimensions, and most of them are NOT functional.", từ "dimension" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key point: greatness lies along many dimensions, and most of them are NOT functional.", what does "dimension" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dimension /daɪˈmen.ʃən/ (danh từ): khía cạnh, phương diện. "Many dimensions of quality" = nhiều khía cạnh của chất lượng; nghĩa khác: kích thước (chiều dài, rộng, cao).
items.explanationEn: dimension /daɪˈmen.ʃən/ (noun): an aspect of something. "Many dimensions of quality" means many aspects; another sense is a measurement such as length or width.

items.question: Trong câu "they assume it is reliable.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they assume it is reliable.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): mặc định cho rằng. "Assume that..." = cho rằng điều gì đúng mà không kiểm chứng; "assume responsibility" = nhận trách nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to believe without proof. "Assume that..." means taking it as true without checking; "assume responsibility" means taking it on.

items.question: Trong câu "Users find them hard to articulate.", từ "articulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users find them hard to articulate.", what does "articulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): diễn đạt rõ ràng. "Hard to articulate" = khó diễn đạt thành lời; tính từ "articulate" = ăn nói lưu loát.
items.explanationEn: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to express clearly. "Hard to articulate" means difficult to put into words; the adjective "articulate" means well-spoken.

items.question: Trong câu "They are implicit.", từ "implicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are implicit.", what does "implicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: implicit /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm, không nói ra. "Implicit requirements" = yêu cầu ngầm định; trái nghĩa: explicit. "Implicit trust" lại là tin tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: implicit /ɪmˈplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): understood but not stated. "Implicit requirements" are assumed, not stated; opposite: explicit. "Implicit trust" means complete trust.

items.question: Trong câu "Discovering late that the system must serve 10,000 concurrent users instead of 100, or must run on mobile devices, can force a rewrite of much of the system.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discovering late that the system must serve 10,000 concurrent users instead of 100, or must run on mobile devices, can force a rewrite of much of the system.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. "Concurrent users" = số người dùng cùng lúc; danh từ: concurrency (tính đồng thời).
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Concurrent users" are people using the system at the same moment; noun: concurrency.

items.question: Trong câu "Retrofitting these characteristics after the fact is usually far more expensive than designing for them up front.", từ "retrofit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retrofitting these characteristics after the fact is usually far more expensive than designing for them up front.", what does "retrofit" (verb) mean?
options: bổ sung vào sau (khi đã làm xong)
optionsEn: to add to something already built
to take out of a system
items.explanation: retrofit /ˈret.rəʊ.fɪt/ (động từ): bổ sung vào sau (khi đã làm xong). "Retrofit X" = lắp thêm/bổ sung X vào thứ đã hoàn thành, thường tốn kém.
items.explanationEn: retrofit /ˈret.rəʊ.fɪt/ (verb): to add to something already built. "Retrofit X" means adding X to something already finished, usually at high cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Retrofitting these characteristics after the fact is usually far more expensive than designing for them up front.", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retrofitting these characteristics after the fact is usually far more expensive than designing for them up front.", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Design up front" = thiết kế từ trước; "pay up front" = trả tiền trước.
items.explanationEn: up front /ʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): at the beginning. "Design up front" means doing it in advance; "pay up front" means paying before you receive it.

items.question: Trong câu "Instead ask about concrete scenarios:", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead ask about concrete scenarios:", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "A concrete example/scenario" = ví dụ/tình huống cụ thể; danh từ "concrete" là bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (adjective): specific and real. "A concrete example or scenario" is a specific one; the noun "concrete" is a building material.

items.question: Trong câu "Determine which attributes matter most and what stakeholders are willing to trade away.", từ "trade away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Determine which attributes matter most and what stakeholders are willing to trade away.", what does "trade away" (phrase) mean?
options: chấp nhận hy sinh (để đổi lấy)
items.explanation: trade away /treɪd əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): chấp nhận hy sinh (để đổi lấy). "Trade away X" = từ bỏ X để đổi lấy thứ khác quan trọng hơn; liên quan: trade-off (sự đánh đổi).
items.explanationEn: trade away /treɪd əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to give up in exchange. "Trade away X" means giving it up to gain something more important; related: trade-off.

items.question: Trong câu "But customers are often unwilling to pay for them, so the development team must raise and justify them.", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But customers are often unwilling to pay for them, so the development team must raise and justify them.", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to align text to both edges
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌs.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): chứng minh là hợp lý. "Justify a cost/decision" = đưa ra lý do chính đáng; trong soạn thảo "justify" là căn đều hai lề.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌs.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to show to be reasonable. "Justify a cost or decision" means giving good reasons for it; in word processing it means aligning text to both margins.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not something you optimise — it is something you must obey.", từ "obey" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not something you optimise — it is something you must obey.", what does "obey" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: obey /əˈbeɪ/ (động từ): tuân theo, chấp hành. "Obey a rule/constraint" = tuân thủ quy tắc/ràng buộc; trái nghĩa: disobey.
items.explanationEn: obey /əˈbeɪ/ (verb): to follow a rule. "Obey a rule or constraint" means following it; opposite: disobey.

items.question: Trong câu "limit how code is written: mandated programming language, permitted libraries, coding standards.", từ "mandate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "limit how code is written: mandated programming language, permitted libraries, coding standards.", what does "mandate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mandate /ˈmæn.deɪt/ (động từ): quy định bắt buộc. "A mandated language" = ngôn ngữ bị bắt buộc dùng; danh từ "mandate" = yêu cầu chính thức, sự uỷ nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: mandate /ˈmæn.deɪt/ (verb): to officially require. "A mandated language" is one you are required to use; the noun "mandate" is an official order or authority.

items.question: Trong câu "Without one, developers will not know whether the constraint still applies when circumstances change.", từ "circumstance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without one, developers will not know whether the constraint still applies when circumstances change.", what does "circumstance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: circumstance /ˈsɜː.kəm.stæns/ (danh từ): hoàn cảnh, tình hình. "When circumstances change" = khi hoàn cảnh thay đổi; cụm: "under no circumstances" = trong mọi trường hợp đều không.
items.explanationEn: circumstance /ˈsɜː.kəm.stæns/ (noun): the conditions of a situation. "When circumstances change" means when conditions are different; phrase: "under no circumstances" means never.

items.question: Trong câu "Availability measures the fraction of time the system is genuinely available for use.", từ "fraction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Availability measures the fraction of time the system is genuinely available for use.", what does "fraction" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a small group in a party
items.explanation: fraction /ˈfræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): phần, tỷ lệ (của tổng thể). "The fraction of time" = tỷ lệ thời gian; "a fraction of the cost" = một phần nhỏ chi phí.
items.explanationEn: fraction /ˈfræk.ʃən/ (noun): a part of a whole. "The fraction of time" is the proportion of time; "a fraction of the cost" means a small part of it.

items.question: Trong câu "Each additional nine makes the COST SOAR.", từ "soar" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each additional nine makes the COST SOAR.", what does "soar" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to glide high in the air
items.explanation: soar /sɔːr/ (động từ): tăng vọt. "Costs/prices soar" = chi phí/giá cả tăng vọt; nghĩa đen: chim bay vút lên cao.
items.explanationEn: soar /sɔːr/ (verb): to rise very quickly. "Costs or prices soar" means they rise sharply; literally, a bird flying high.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask stakeholders about the real cost of each hour of downtime to choose a sensible level.", từ "downtime" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask stakeholders about the real cost of each hour of downtime to choose a sensible level.", what does "downtime" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: time a system is not working
items.explanation: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (danh từ): thời gian ngừng hoạt động. "Planned downtime" = thời gian dừng hệ thống có kế hoạch (bảo trì); với người, "downtime" là thời gian nghỉ ngơi.
items.explanationEn: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (noun): time a system is not working. "Planned downtime" is scheduled time offline for maintenance; for people, "downtime" means time to relax.

items.question: Trong câu "Is a degraded mode needed, where some functions keep working when others fail?", từ "degraded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is a degraded mode needed, where some functions keep working when others fail?", what does "degraded" (adjective) mean?
options: bị hạ nhục, mất phẩm giá
items.explanation: degraded /dɪˈɡreɪ.dɪd/ (tính từ): bị suy giảm (chức năng). "Degraded mode" = chế độ chạy giảm chức năng khi có sự cố; với người, "degraded" là bị hạ nhục.
items.explanationEn: degraded /dɪˈɡreɪ.dɪd/ (adjective): working at a reduced level. "Degraded mode" means running with reduced functions after a fault; for people "degraded" means humiliated.

items.question: Trong câu "Can an installation roll back if it fails?", từ "roll back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can an installation roll back if it fails?", what does "roll back" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to move back by turning over
to return to the previous state
items.explanation: roll back /rəʊl bæk/ (cụm từ): quay về trạng thái trước. "Roll back a change/installation" = hoàn tác về trạng thái trước; danh từ: rollback.
items.explanationEn: roll back /rəʊl bæk/ (phrase): to return to the previous state. "Roll back a change or installation" means undoing it back to the earlier state; noun: rollback.

items.question: Trong câu "Must the application be installable without administrator privileges?", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Must the application be installable without administrator privileges?", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn (truy cập). "Administrator privileges" = quyền quản trị; "it is a privilege to..." = thật vinh dự khi...
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a special access right. "Administrator privileges" are admin access rights; "it is a privilege to..." means it is an honour to...

items.question: Trong câu "Does upgrading preserve user data and settings?", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does upgrading preserve user data and settings?", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep food from going bad
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ nguyên, bảo toàn. "Preserve data/settings" = giữ nguyên dữ liệu/cài đặt; nghĩa khác: bảo quản thực phẩm.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep unchanged. "Preserve data or settings" means keeping them intact; another sense is keeping food from spoiling.

items.question: Trong câu "Integrity deals with preventing data loss and corruption.", từ "corruption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integrity deals with preventing data loss and corruption.", what does "corruption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: corruption /kəˈrʌp.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hư hỏng (dữ liệu). "Data corruption" = dữ liệu bị hỏng, sai lệch; trong chính trị "corruption" là tham nhũng.
items.explanationEn: corruption /kəˈrʌp.ʃən/ (noun): damage to data. "Data corruption" means data becoming damaged or wrong; in politics "corruption" means dishonest use of power.

items.question: Trong câu "integrity focuses on ensuring data is not corrupted, lost, or distorted — whether by a software defect, a hardware failure, or a mistake by a legitimate user.", từ "distort" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "integrity focuses on ensuring data is not corrupted, lost, or distorted — whether by a software defect, a hardware failure, or a mistake by a legitimate user.", what does "distort" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change into a false form
items.explanation: distort /dɪˈstɔːt/ (động từ): làm sai lệch, bóp méo. "Distorted data/facts" = dữ liệu/sự thật bị bóp méo; đừng nhầm với "distract" (làm xao nhãng).
items.explanationEn: distort /dɪˈstɔːt/ (verb): to change into a false form. "Distorted data or facts" have been twisted out of shape; do not confuse it with "distract".

items.question: Trong câu "Interoperability indicates how readily the system exchanges data and services with other systems.", từ "readily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interoperability indicates how readily the system exchanges data and services with other systems.", what does "readily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: readily /ˈred.ɪ.li/ (trạng từ): dễ dàng, không trở ngại. "Readily available" = có sẵn, dễ lấy; "readily agree" = sẵn lòng đồng ý.
items.explanationEn: readily /ˈred.ɪ.li/ (adverb): easily, without difficulty. "Readily available" means easy to get; "readily agree" means agreeing willingly.

items.question: Trong câu "Performance is the responsiveness of the system — the time needed to respond to events, or the number of events processed in a given interval.", từ "interval" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Performance is the responsiveness of the system — the time needed to respond to events, or the number of events processed in a given interval.", what does "interval" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a period between points in time
items.explanation: interval /ˈɪn.tə.vəl/ (danh từ): khoảng thời gian. "In a given interval" = trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định; "at regular intervals" = định kỳ.
items.explanationEn: interval /ˈɪn.tə.vəl/ (noun): a period between points in time. "In a given interval" means within a set period; "at regular intervals" means periodically.

items.question: Trong câu "Always state: what is measured, under what load conditions, and what threshold is acceptable.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always state: what is measured, under what load conditions, and what threshold is acceptable.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng (giá trị). "An acceptable threshold" = ngưỡng chấp nhận được; nghĩa đen là bậc cửa ra vào.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.həʊld/ (noun): a limit level. "An acceptable threshold" is the limit value that is still OK; literally it is the bottom of a doorway.

items.question: Trong câu "If performance requirements are demanding, the architect needs to know from the outset to pick the right caching, sharding, and asynchronous processing strategies.", từ "from the outset" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If performance requirements are demanding, the architect needs to know from the outset to pick the right caching, sharding, and asynchronous processing strategies.", what does "from the outset" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: from the outset /frɒm ði ˈaʊt.set/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "From the outset" = ngay từ lúc bắt đầu; đồng nghĩa: from the start, up front.
items.explanationEn: from the outset /frɒm ði ˈaʊt.set/ (phrase): from the very start. "From the outset" means from the beginning; synonyms: from the start, up front.

items.question: Trong câu "The reliability you need depends on the consequences of failure.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reliability you need depends on the consequences of failure.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả. "The consequences of failure" = hậu quả của sự cố; "as a consequence" = do đó.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result of an action. "The consequences of failure" are its results; "as a consequence" means as a result.

items.question: Trong câu "Does it reject it gracefully with a useful message, or crash?", từ "gracefully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does it reject it gracefully with a useful message, or crash?", what does "gracefully" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: gracefully /ˈɡreɪs.fəl.i/ (trạng từ): êm thấm, có kiểm soát. "Fail/degrade gracefully" = hỏng một cách có kiểm soát, không sập đột ngột; nghĩa thường: duyên dáng.
items.explanationEn: gracefully /ˈɡreɪs.fəl.i/ (adverb): smoothly, without breaking. "Fail or degrade gracefully" means handling failure smoothly; the everyday sense is moving elegantly.

items.question: Trong câu "Fault tolerance — does the system keep operating when a component fails?", từ "tolerance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fault tolerance — does the system keep operating when a component fails?", what does "tolerance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tolerance /ˈtɒl.ər.əns/ (danh từ): khả năng chịu (lỗi). "Fault tolerance" = khả năng chịu lỗi; trong kỹ thuật còn là dung sai; với người là lòng khoan dung.
items.explanationEn: tolerance /ˈtɒl.ər.əns/ (noun): the ability to withstand faults. "Fault tolerance" is the ability to keep working despite faults; in engineering also an allowed margin; for people, open-mindedness.

items.question: Trong câu "Recovery — after a failure, does the system recover on its own or does it need manual intervention?", từ "intervention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recovery — after a failure, does the system recover on its own or does it need manual intervention?", what does "intervention" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: action taken to change a situation
items.explanation: intervention /ˌɪn.təˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự can thiệp. "Manual intervention" = sự can thiệp thủ công của con người.
items.explanationEn: intervention /ˌɪn.təˈven.ʃən/ (noun): action taken to change a situation. "Manual intervention" means a person has to step in and act.

items.question: Trong câu "Safety requirements concern preventing harm to people, property, or the environment.", từ "harm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Safety requirements concern preventing harm to people, property, or the environment.", what does "harm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: harm /hɑːm/ (danh từ): sự tổn hại. "Prevent harm to people" = ngăn gây hại cho con người; tính từ: harmful, harmless.
items.explanationEn: harm /hɑːm/ (noun): damage or injury. "Prevent harm to people" means stopping injury to them; adjectives: harmful, harmless.

items.question: Trong câu "Safety requirements usually derive from:", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Safety requirements usually derive from:", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): bắt nguồn từ. "Derive from X" = xuất phát từ X; "derived requirements" = yêu cầu được suy ra.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to come from a source. "Derive from X" means to come from X; "derived requirements" are worked out from higher-level ones.

items.question: Trong câu "Hazard analysis — identifying what can go wrong and what the consequences are.", từ "hazard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hazard analysis — identifying what can go wrong and what the consequences are.", what does "hazard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hazard /ˈhæz.əd/ (danh từ): mối nguy hiểm. "Hazard analysis" = phân tích mối nguy; cụm: fire hazard (nguy cơ cháy).
items.explanationEn: hazard /ˈhæz.əd/ (noun): a source of danger. "Hazard analysis" identifies sources of danger; collocation: fire hazard.

items.question: Trong câu "Product certification — the product must pass an inspection before it can be sold.", từ "inspection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Product certification — the product must pass an inspection before it can be sold.", what does "inspection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: inspection /ɪnˈspek.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự kiểm định, thanh tra. "Pass an inspection" = vượt qua đợt kiểm định; động từ: inspect.
items.explanationEn: inspection /ɪnˈspek.ʃən/ (noun): an official examination. "Pass an inspection" means meeting an official check; verb: inspect.

items.question: Trong câu "For safety-critical systems, requirements tracing is MANDATORY, not optional.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For safety-critical systems, requirements tracing is MANDATORY, not optional.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory field/training" = trường/khoá học bắt buộc; trái nghĩa: optional.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (adjective): required by rule. "A mandatory field or training" must be completed; opposite: optional.

items.question: Trong câu "Security requirements concern protection from unauthorized access, use, modification, disclosure, or destruction.", từ "disclosure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security requirements concern protection from unauthorized access, use, modification, disclosure, or destruction.", what does "disclosure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disclosure /dɪsˈkləʊ.ʒər/ (danh từ): sự tiết lộ (thông tin). "Unauthorized disclosure" = tiết lộ trái phép; động từ: disclose.
items.explanationEn: disclosure /dɪsˈkləʊ.ʒər/ (noun): revealing information. "Unauthorized disclosure" means revealing data without permission; verb: disclose.

items.question: Trong câu "Is undeniable proof needed that a transaction took place?", từ "undeniable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is undeniable proof needed that a transaction took place?", what does "undeniable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: undeniable /ˌʌn.dɪˈnaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể chối cãi. "Undeniable proof" = bằng chứng không thể chối cãi; liên quan: non-repudiation (chống chối bỏ).
items.explanationEn: undeniable /ˌʌn.dɪˈnaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to dispute. "Undeniable proof" cannot be disputed; related concept: non-repudiation.

items.question: Trong câu "Identify which regulations apply, because they usually impose non-negotiable requirements.", từ "non-negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Identify which regulations apply, because they usually impose non-negotiable requirements.", what does "non-negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: non-negotiable /ˌnɒn.nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể thương lượng. "Non-negotiable" = bắt buộc, không thể mặc cả; "negotiable" = có thể thương lượng.
items.explanationEn: non-negotiable /ˌnɒn.nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.ə.bəl/ (adjective): not open to discussion. "Non-negotiable" means fixed and not up for bargaining; "negotiable" means open to discussion.

items.question: Trong câu "Usability — sometimes called human engineering or ease of use — covers a large space of characteristics that make software accessible, learnable, and easy to use.", từ "accessible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Usability — sometimes called human engineering or ease of use — covers a large space of characteristics that make software accessible, learnable, and easy to use.", what does "accessible" (adjective) mean?
options: dễ lây lan sang người khác
được bảo mật rất chặt chẽ
dễ tiếp cận (kể cả người khuyết tật)
optionsEn: usable by people of all abilities
items.explanation: accessible /əkˈses.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): dễ tiếp cận (kể cả người khuyết tật). "Accessible software" = phần mềm mọi người, kể cả người khuyết tật, đều dùng được; danh từ: accessibility.
items.explanationEn: accessible /əkˈses.ə.bəl/ (adjective): usable by people of all abilities. "Accessible software" can be used by everyone, including people with disabilities; noun: accessibility.

items.question: Trong câu "How quickly a newcomer learns to use it", từ "newcomer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How quickly a newcomer learns to use it", what does "newcomer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who has just arrived
items.explanation: newcomer /ˈnjuː.kʌm.ər/ (danh từ): người mới. "A newcomer to X" = người mới tham gia/mới dùng X; đồng nghĩa: novice, beginner.
items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnjuː.kʌm.ər/ (noun): a person who has just arrived. "A newcomer to X" is someone new to it; synonyms: novice, beginner.

items.question: Trong câu "Supportability — how easily the support organization diagnoses and resolves user problems.", từ "diagnose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Supportability — how easily the support organization diagnoses and resolves user problems.", what does "diagnose" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find the cause of a problem
items.explanation: diagnose /ˈdaɪ.əɡ.nəʊz/ (động từ): xác định nguyên nhân (sự cố). "Diagnose a problem" = tìm ra nguyên nhân sự cố; tính từ: diagnostic (vd. diagnostic logging).
items.explanationEn: diagnose /ˈdaɪ.əɡ.nəʊz/ (verb): to find the cause of a problem. "Diagnose a problem" means finding its cause; adjective: diagnostic (e.g. diagnostic logging).

items.question: Trong câu "Localizability — how easily the product adapts to different languages, currencies, date formats, alphabets, and cultural conventions.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Localizability — how easily the product adapts to different languages, currencies, date formats, alphabets, and cultural conventions.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước, tập quán. "Cultural conventions" = tập quán văn hoá; "naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên; nghĩa khác: hội nghị.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): an accepted custom. "Cultural conventions" are accepted customs; "naming convention" is an agreed naming rule; another sense is a large conference.

items.question: Trong câu "The development team usually has to raise and justify them proactively.", từ "proactively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The development team usually has to raise and justify them proactively.", what does "proactively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: proactively /prəʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): một cách chủ động. "Act proactively" = chủ động làm trước khi có vấn đề; trái nghĩa: reactively.
items.explanationEn: proactively /prəʊˈæk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): by acting in advance. "Act proactively" means acting before problems arise; opposite: reactively.

items.question: Trong câu "Performance is how fast the system responds; efficiency is how much resource it consumes to do so.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Performance is how fast the system responds; efficiency is how much resource it consumes to do so.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu thụ, sử dụng. "Consume memory/battery" = tiêu tốn bộ nhớ/pin; danh từ: consumption.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume memory or battery" means using it up; noun: consumption.

items.question: Trong câu "A system can be fast but resource-hungry (inefficient), or frugal but slow.", từ "frugal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A system can be fast but resource-hungry (inefficient), or frugal but slow.", what does "frugal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frugal /ˈfruː.ɡəl/ (tính từ): tiết kiệm, dùng ít. "Frugal with resources" = dùng tài nguyên dè sẻn; trái nghĩa: wasteful, resource-hungry.
items.explanationEn: frugal /ˈfruː.ɡəl/ (adjective): using little. "Frugal with resources" means using very little; opposites: wasteful, resource-hungry.

items.question: Trong câu "Efficiency is especially important in embedded systems, where hardware resources are tightly bounded and cannot be expanded.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Efficiency is especially important in embedded systems, where hardware resources are tightly bounded and cannot be expanded.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): bị giới hạn. "Tightly bounded resources" = tài nguyên bị giới hạn chặt; "bound" (động từ) còn nghĩa là nhảy vọt.
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): kept within limits. "Tightly bounded resources" have strict limits; the verb "bound" can also mean to leap.

items.question: Trong câu "It depends on code structure, documentation, and the coupling between modules.", từ "coupling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It depends on code structure, documentation, and the coupling between modules.", what does "coupling" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coupling /ˈkʌp.lɪŋ/ (danh từ): mức liên kết phụ thuộc. "Loose/tight coupling" = liên kết lỏng/chặt giữa các module; nghĩa cơ khí: khớp nối.
items.explanationEn: coupling /ˈkʌp.lɪŋ/ (noun): the degree of dependency. "Loose or tight coupling" describes how dependent modules are; in mechanics it is a joining device.

items.question: Trong câu "A common way to achieve modifiability: move business rules out of hard-coded logic into configuration tables or a rule engine, so changing them does not require recompilation.", từ "hard-coded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common way to achieve modifiability: move business rules out of hard-coded logic into configuration tables or a rule engine, so changing them does not require recompilation.", what does "hard-coded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hard-coded /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊ.dɪd/ (tính từ): viết cứng trong mã. "Hard-coded values" = giá trị gắn cứng trong mã, muốn đổi phải sửa và biên dịch lại.
items.explanationEn: hard-coded /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊ.dɪd/ (adjective): fixed directly in the code. "Hard-coded values" are fixed in the source, so changing them means editing and rebuilding.

items.question: Trong câu "Portability measures the effort needed to migrate the software to a different operating environment — a different operating system, hardware platform, browser, or database.", từ "migrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Portability measures the effort needed to migrate the software to a different operating environment — a different operating system, hardware platform, browser, or database.", what does "migrate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to a new environment
items.explanation: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (động từ): chuyển sang (môi trường khác). "Migrate to a new platform/database" = chuyển hệ thống sang nền tảng mới; danh từ: migration.
items.explanationEn: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (verb): to move to a new environment. "Migrate to a new platform or database" means moving the system there; noun: migration.

items.question: Trong câu "If you know the application will eventually need to run on multiple platforms, you will isolate platform-dependent code from the outset.", từ "isolate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you know the application will eventually need to run on multiple platforms, you will isolate platform-dependent code from the outset.", what does "isolate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: isolate /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪt/ (động từ): tách riêng, cô lập. "Isolate dependent code/components" = tách riêng để dễ thay thế/kiểm thử; danh từ: isolation.
items.explanationEn: isolate /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪt/ (verb): to separate from the rest. "Isolate dependent code or components" means separating them so they are easy to swap or test; noun: isolation.

items.question: Trong câu "If you know the application will eventually need to run on multiple platforms, you will isolate platform-dependent code from the outset.", từ "eventually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you know the application will eventually need to run on multiple platforms, you will isolate platform-dependent code from the outset.", what does "eventually" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the end, after some time
items.explanation: eventually /ɪˈven.tʃu.ə.li/ (trạng từ): cuối cùng, rốt cuộc. "Eventually" = sau một thời gian thì...; lưu ý: KHÔNG mang nghĩa "có thể, có lẽ".
items.explanationEn: eventually /ɪˈven.tʃu.ə.li/ (adverb): in the end, after some time. "Eventually" means in the end; unlike similar words in some languages, it does not mean "possibly".

items.question: Trong câu "Ask: which components will be reused, where, and who is responsible for maintaining them as a shared asset?", từ "asset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask: which components will be reused, where, and who is responsible for maintaining them as a shared asset?", what does "asset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: asset /ˈæs.et/ (danh từ): tài sản (có giá trị). "A shared asset" = tài sản dùng chung; "he is an asset to the team" = người có giá trị cho nhóm.
items.explanationEn: asset /ˈæs.et/ (noun): something valuable owned. "A shared asset" is a valuable resource used by many; "an asset to the team" is a valuable person.

items.question: Trong câu "Factors that affect it: the degree of complex and nested logic, the ability to isolate components for testing, and the existence of diagnostic interfaces and hooks.", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Factors that affect it: the degree of complex and nested logic, the ability to isolate components for testing, and the existence of diagnostic interfaces and hooks.", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nested /ˈnes.tɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau. "Nested logic/loops" = logic/vòng lặp lồng trong nhau; gốc "nest" là tổ chim.
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnes.tɪd/ (adjective): placed one inside another. "Nested logic or loops" sit inside each other; the root "nest" is a bird's home.

items.question: Trong câu "Factors that affect it: the degree of complex and nested logic, the ability to isolate components for testing, and the existence of diagnostic interfaces and hooks.", từ "hook" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Factors that affect it: the degree of complex and nested logic, the ability to isolate components for testing, and the existence of diagnostic interfaces and hooks.", what does "hook" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a point to insert extra code
a catchy part of a song
items.explanation: hook /hʊk/ (danh từ): điểm móc nối (trong mã). "Test hooks" = điểm cài sẵn trong mã để kiểm thử/can thiệp; nghĩa thường: cái móc.
items.explanationEn: hook /hʊk/ (noun): a point to insert extra code. "Test hooks" are built-in points where tests can plug in; the everyday sense is a curved hanger.

items.question: Trong câu "Generalized components carry abstraction overhead", từ "overhead" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Generalized components carry abstraction overhead", what does "overhead" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overhead /ˈəʊ.və.hed/ (danh từ): chi phí phụ thêm (tài nguyên). "Performance overhead" = phần tài nguyên/thời gian tốn thêm; trong kế toán là chi phí chung.
items.explanationEn: overhead /ˈəʊ.və.hed/ (noun): extra cost in resources. "Performance overhead" is the extra time or resources spent; in accounting it means running costs.

items.question: Trong câu "The person who bears the consequences should make the decision.", từ "bear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The person who bears the consequences should make the decision.", what does "bear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bear /beər/ (động từ): gánh chịu. "Bear the consequences/cost" = gánh chịu hậu quả/chi phí; "bear in mind" = ghi nhớ.
items.explanationEn: bear /beər/ (verb): to accept and suffer. "Bear the consequences or cost" means accepting them; "bear in mind" means to remember.

items.question: Trong câu "A banking system required automatic logout after 3 minutes of inactivity (security), while customer service complained that agents were constantly logged out mid-call with customers (usability).", từ "inactivity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A banking system required automatic logout after 3 minutes of inactivity (security), while customer service complained that agents were constantly logged out mid-call with customers (usability).", what does "inactivity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: inactivity /ˌɪn.ækˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự không hoạt động. "Logout after N minutes of inactivity" = tự đăng xuất khi người dùng không thao tác N phút.
items.explanationEn: inactivity /ˌɪn.ækˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (noun): a state of doing nothing. "Logout after N minutes of inactivity" means signing out when the user does nothing for that time.

items.question: Trong câu "they settled on 15 minutes for workstations in secure areas and 3 minutes for remote access.", từ "settle on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they settled on 15 minutes for workstations in secure areas and 3 minutes for remote access.", what does "settle on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: settle on /ˈset.əl ɒn/ (cụm từ): thống nhất chọn. "Settle on an option" = cuối cùng thống nhất chọn phương án; "settle in" lại là ổn định chỗ ở.
items.explanationEn: settle on /ˈset.əl ɒn/ (phrase): to decide on after discussion. "Settle on an option" means finally agreeing on it; "settle in" means getting comfortable in a new place.

items.question: Trong câu "Tom Gilb developed Planguage — a keyword-driven language that lets you specify quality attributes with far greater precision.", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tom Gilb developed Planguage — a keyword-driven language that lets you specify quality attributes with far greater precision.", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. "With precision" = một cách chính xác; tính từ: precise.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness. "With precision" means exactly; adjective: precise.

items.question: Trong câu "How it is measured — the method or instrument used to obtain a value on the Scale", từ "instrument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How it is measured — the method or instrument used to obtain a value on the Scale", what does "instrument" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instrument /ˈɪn.strə.mənt/ (danh từ): công cụ đo lường. "Measuring instrument" = dụng cụ đo; "musical instrument" = nhạc cụ.
items.explanationEn: instrument /ˈɪn.strə.mənt/ (noun): a tool for measuring. "A measuring instrument" is a tool for measurement; "a musical instrument" is for playing music.

items.question: Trong câu "The ideal level in a perfect world — not a commitment", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ideal level in a perfect world — not a commitment", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): sự cam kết. "Make a commitment" = đưa ra cam kết; động từ: commit to (cam kết với).
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): a promise to do something. "Make a commitment" means promising something; verb: commit to.

items.question: Trong câu "The projected level needed in the future", từ "projected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The projected level needed in the future", what does "projected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: projected /prəˈdʒek.tɪd/ (tính từ): được dự báo. "Projected growth/cost" = mức tăng trưởng/chi phí dự kiến; nghĩa khác: được chiếu lên màn hình.
items.explanationEn: projected /prəˈdʒek.tɪd/ (adjective): estimated for the future. "Projected growth or cost" is the forecast figure; another sense is shown on a screen.

items.question: Trong câu "Measured with a performance monitoring tool across 1,000 random queries in a test environment with 500 simulated concurrent users; report the 95th percentile.", từ "percentile" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Measured with a performance monitoring tool across 1,000 random queries in a test environment with 500 simulated concurrent users; report the 95th percentile.", what does "percentile" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value below which a share of data falls
items.explanation: percentile /pəˈsen.taɪl/ (danh từ): phân vị (thống kê). "The 95th percentile" = giá trị mà 95% số lần đo nằm dưới nó; hay dùng cho thời gian phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: percentile /pəˈsen.taɪl/ (noun): a value below which a share of data falls. "The 95th percentile" is the value that 95% of measurements fall below; common for response times.

items.question: Trong câu "Past: 12 seconds (current legacy system).", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Past: 12 seconds (current legacy system).", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ (vẫn đang dùng). "Legacy system" = hệ thống cũ vẫn đang vận hành; danh từ "legacy" là di sản.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. "A legacy system" is an old system still in use; the noun "legacy" means something inherited.

items.question: Trong câu "Must / Plan / Wish make three distinct levels explicit, instead of collapsing everything into one number where nobody knows if it is mandatory or aspirational.", từ "collapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Must / Plan / Wish make three distinct levels explicit, instead of collapsing everything into one number where nobody knows if it is mandatory or aspirational.", what does "collapse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (động từ): gộp lại, thu gọn. "Collapse X into one" = gộp nhiều thứ thành một; nghĩa thường: sụp đổ, ngã quỵ.
items.explanationEn: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (verb): to combine into one. "Collapse X into one" means merging them together; the usual sense is falling down.

items.question: Trong câu "Must / Plan / Wish make three distinct levels explicit, instead of collapsing everything into one number where nobody knows if it is mandatory or aspirational.", từ "aspirational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Must / Plan / Wish make three distinct levels explicit, instead of collapsing everything into one number where nobody knows if it is mandatory or aspirational.", what does "aspirational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: aspirational /ˌæs.pɪˈreɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): mang tính mong ước. "An aspirational goal" = mục tiêu mong muốn đạt tới nhưng không cam kết; danh từ: aspiration.
items.explanationEn: aspirational /ˌæs.pɪˈreɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): hoped for, not required. "An aspirational goal" is hoped for but not promised; noun: aspiration.

items.question: Trong câu "Use it for the most important, riskiest, and most contentious quality attributes — where precision actually makes a difference.", từ "contentious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use it for the most important, riskiest, and most contentious quality attributes — where precision actually makes a difference.", what does "contentious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contentious /kənˈten.ʃəs/ (tính từ): gây tranh cãi. "A contentious issue" = vấn đề gây tranh cãi; đừng nhầm với "content" (hài lòng).
items.explanationEn: contentious /kənˈten.ʃəs/ (adjective): likely to cause argument. "A contentious issue" causes disagreement; do not confuse it with "content" (satisfied).

items.question: Trong câu "If Planguage feels too heavyweight for your project, at minimum always state three things:", từ "heavyweight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If Planguage feels too heavyweight for your project, at minimum always state three things:", what does "heavyweight" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: in the top boxing weight class
items.explanation: heavyweight /ˈhev.i.weɪt/ (tính từ): nặng nề, cồng kềnh. "A heavyweight process" = quy trình nặng nề, nhiều thủ tục; trái nghĩa: lightweight.
items.explanationEn: heavyweight /ˈhev.i.weɪt/ (adjective): too complex and formal. "A heavyweight process" has lots of formality; opposite: lightweight.

items.question: Trong câu "Quality attributes pose a particular challenge for agile, because they usually span many user stories rather than belonging to any one story.", từ "pose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quality attributes pose a particular challenge for agile, because they usually span many user stories rather than belonging to any one story.", what does "pose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pose /pəʊz/ (động từ): đặt ra, gây ra. "Pose a challenge/risk/question" = đặt ra thách thức/rủi ro/câu hỏi; nghĩa khác: tạo dáng.
items.explanationEn: pose /pəʊz/ (verb): to present or create. "Pose a challenge, risk or question" means creating one; another sense is sitting for a photo.

items.question: Trong câu "Quality attributes pose a particular challenge for agile, because they usually span many user stories rather than belonging to any one story.", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quality attributes pose a particular challenge for agile, because they usually span many user stories rather than belonging to any one story.", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng qua. "Span many stories/years" = trải dài qua nhiều story/năm; danh từ: "time span" = khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. "Span many stories or years" means extending across them; noun: "time span".

items.question: Trong câu "Fold them into the acceptance criteria of related stories.", từ "fold into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fold them into the acceptance criteria of related stories.", what does "fold into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fold into /fəʊld ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): lồng ghép vào. "Fold X into Y" = đưa X vào làm một phần của Y; nghĩa đen: gấp lại.
items.explanationEn: fold into /fəʊld ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to include as part of. "Fold X into Y" means making X part of Y; literally, bending something over itself.

items.question: Trong câu "When a quality attribute demands substantial architectural work (such as building a caching tier to hit a performance target), the team can create a separate technical story and put it in the backlog.", từ "substantial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a quality attribute demands substantial architectural work (such as building a caching tier to hit a performance target), the team can create a separate technical story and put it in the backlog.", what does "substantial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: substantial /səbˈstæn.ʃəl/ (tính từ): đáng kể, lớn. "Substantial work/effort" = khối lượng công việc đáng kể; đừng nhầm với "substitute".
items.explanationEn: substantial /səbˈstæn.ʃəl/ (adjective): large in amount. "Substantial work or effort" means a large amount; do not confuse it with "substitute".

items.question: Trong câu "can be revisited when the licence lapses; but if the reason is integration with a legacy system, it will outlive the licence.", từ "lapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "can be revisited when the licence lapses; but if the reason is integration with a legacy system, it will outlive the licence.", what does "lapse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lapse /læps/ (động từ): hết hiệu lực. "The licence lapses" = giấy phép hết hạn; danh từ "a lapse" còn là sơ suất nhất thời.
items.explanationEn: lapse /læps/ (verb): to expire, to end. "The licence lapses" means it expires; the noun "a lapse" is also a brief mistake.

items.question: Trong câu "can be revisited when the licence lapses; but if the reason is integration with a legacy system, it will outlive the licence.", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "can be revisited when the licence lapses; but if the reason is integration with a legacy system, it will outlive the licence.", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. "Outlive its usefulness" = tồn tại quá lâu đến mức hết hữu dụng.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. "Outlive its usefulness" means continuing to exist after it stops being useful.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements writers often slip design decisions into requirements.", từ "slip into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements writers often slip design decisions into requirements.", what does "slip into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: slip into /slɪp ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): lén đưa vào. "Slip X into Y" = lặng lẽ chèn X vào Y mà người khác khó để ý; nghĩa đen: trượt vào.
items.explanationEn: slip into /slɪp ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to put in quietly. "Slip X into Y" means inserting it quietly so few notice; literally, sliding into something.

items.question: Trong câu "Quality attributes are things stakeholders care about deeply but rarely state — you must elicit them actively.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quality attributes are things stakeholders care about deeply but rarely state — you must elicit them actively.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /ɪˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập. "Elicit requirements" = khai thác yêu cầu từ stakeholder; đừng nhầm với "illicit" (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /ɪˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements" means drawing them out of stakeholders; do not confuse it with "illicit".

items.question: Trong câu "ask about concrete scenarios and the consequences of falling short.", từ "fall short" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ask about concrete scenarios and the consequences of falling short.", what does "fall short" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to fail to reach a standard
items.explanation: fall short /fɔːl ʃɔːt/ (cụm từ): không đạt yêu cầu. "Fall short of expectations" = không đạt kỳ vọng.
items.explanationEn: fall short /fɔːl ʃɔːt/ (phrase): to fail to reach a standard. "Fall short of expectations" means failing to meet them.

items.question: Trong câu "Quality attributes largely determine the perceived quality of the product", từ "perceived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quality attributes largely determine the perceived quality of the product", what does "perceived" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: perceived /pəˈsiːvd/ (tính từ): được cảm nhận. "Perceived quality" = chất lượng theo cảm nhận của người dùng; động từ: perceive.
items.explanationEn: perceived /pəˈsiːvd/ (adjective): as seen by people. "Perceived quality" is quality as users experience it; verb: perceive.

items.question: Trong câu "Select the handful of attributes that genuinely matter for this system rather than trying to specify them all.", từ "handful" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Select the handful of attributes that genuinely matter for this system rather than trying to specify them all.", what does "handful" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handful /ˈhænd.fʊl/ (danh từ): một số ít. "A handful of X" = một vài X; "a handful" còn chỉ người khó bảo.
items.explanationEn: handful /ˈhænd.fʊl/ (noun): a small number. "A handful of X" means a few X; "a handful" can also describe a difficult person.

items.question: Trong câu "Planguage gives you a ready-made frame for this.", từ "ready-made" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planguage gives you a ready-made frame for this.", what does "ready-made" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ready-made /ˌred.iˈmeɪd/ (tính từ): có sẵn. "A ready-made template/solution" = mẫu/giải pháp có sẵn để dùng ngay.
items.explanationEn: ready-made /ˌred.iˈmeɪd/ (adjective): already prepared. "A ready-made template or solution" is prepared and ready to use.
